statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-114467 is tracked in GitLab work item https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/git/-/work_items/810 . When Git strips GPG signatures from a commit message, remove_signature() in commit.c recorded at most two signatures in a fixed-size stack array, so a message with more than two signatures, for example from git merge of a tag carrying them, wrote past the end of that array. Upstream fixed it in Git 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1, 2.55.1 and 2.56.1, as the Git 2.50.2 release notes describe: https://github.com/git/git/blob/v2.50.2/Documentation/RelNotes/2.50.2.adoc . The fix is in commit https://github.com/git/git/commit/aff587222342473034a270a3a04cfb1eba0a1117 , which rewrites remove_signature() to handle any number of signatures. The 2.52.1-r0 build is Alpine's security upgrade to Git 2.52.1, which contains the fix: https://git.alpinelinux.org/aports/commit/?id=2f20de3527863b1b84f620fefe687921498e7240 . We checked /usr/bin/git, the program in the git package that contains this code, in both published builds, 2.52.0-r0 and 2.52.1-r0, on x86_64 and aarch64: 2.52.1-r0 contains the new error message "index entry path is too long (" from the same security release, and 2.52.0-r0 does not. Earlier builds of this owner predate the fix.

CVE-2026-114467 is tracked in GitLab work item https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/git/-/work_items/810 . When Git strips GPG signatures from a commit message, remove_signature() in commit.c recorded at most two signatures in a fixed-size stack array, so a message with more than two signatures, for example from git merge of a tag carrying them, wrote past the end of that array. Upstream fixed it in Git 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1, 2.55.1 and 2.56.1, as the Git 2.50.2 release notes describe: https://github.com/git/git/blob/v2.50.2/Documentation/RelNotes/2.50.2.adoc . The fix is in commit https://github.com/git/git/commit/aff587222342473034a270a3a04cfb1eba0a1117 , which rewrites remove_signature() to handle any number of signatures. Debian's git 1:2.47.3-0+deb13u1 does not include it, and the Debian tracker lists trixie as vulnerable: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-114467 . DHI backports that commit unmodified. The fixed version is the first build that carries the backport, and its shipped changelog lists it. We compared the git package of the two builds in the DHI Debian repository, on amd64 and arm64, using the symbol tables in git-dbgsym: remove_signature() in /usr/bin/git changes from 594 to 534 bytes on amd64 and from 592 to 524 bytes on arm64 between the build before the fix and the fixed build. Earlier builds of 2.47.3-0+deb13u1 also predate the backport.
